# mabinogi-005 — establishment log (2026-11-12)

Evans 1907 cols 38 l. 12 – 47 l. 27 (PDF pp. 51–56). Every column read on the page image (zoom 4, three crops per
column; spot crops at zoom 8). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate
disagreements and for punctuation shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r; ſ → s; raised
letters into the line (col 41 l. 22 "ch⁶aer" → *chwaer*; col 42 l. 32 "ynyˢ" → *ynys*); line-end marks, Evans's
accents, underlines and suspension marks dropped; marginal marks (! and /) not letters.

## Opening
- col 38 l. 12 — the three-line drop capital **B** of *Bendigeiduran* is on the image (the OCR began "Endigeiduran").

## Worklist items (32 check + 26 loss), decided on the image
All OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the witness agrees with the image (ss for ſſ/ſf, w for 6, r for
r-rotunda, k for the k-sort, minim clusters, a/A sort read as S): col 38 ll. 13, 21, 22, 31, 33; col 39 ll. 20, 22;
col 40 ll. 3, 20; col 41 ll. 6, 10, 22, 24; col 42 ll. 8 (both), 32, 35; col 43 ll. 4, 16 ("uynet", zoom-8 crop), 24,
27, 28, 31, 33; col 44 ll. 9, 13, 31, 36; col 45 ll. 5 ("diruawr"), 7, 14, 19, 23; col 46 ll. 4, 6, 9 (both), 15, 16, 20,
24, 30, 35, 36 (gossot, "ystauell"); col 47 ll. 18, 21, 25, 26.

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 38 l. 26 — **"Penardim"** (zoom-8 crop, certain; the Red Book also *penardim*); the witness's "Penardun" is
  Williams's form. NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the name as both manuscripts write it.
- col 38 l. 30 — **"Y llall"** (Evans *llall*; witness "llal").
- col 41 l. 34 — **"hyt nat oed"** (witness "hyd").
- col 43 l. 4 — **"y gwnaetpwyt"** (no h; the witness supplies "[h]"). A readable slip for *gwnaethpwyt*; kept. NOTE.
- col 43 c. l. 25 — **"a uo kyuref a chyhyt ac ef e hun"**: the witness's supplement "[a'e uys bychan]" is in neither the
  White Book nor the Red Book (*kyvaef achyhyt*) and the sense does not need it: not supplied.
- col 44 l. 22 — **"gan Uendigeituran yn ymdidan"** (zoom-8 crop, certain; the Red Book also *yn ymdidan*); the
  witness's "yr ymdidan" is an emendation. Kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER: construe with care ('dull … the talking'?); say the
  reading is the manuscripts' and that *yr* is the editors' mending.
- col 45 l. 5 — **"ynteu hyny"** (Evans prints *hy̅ny* with a suspension mark, dropped as the conventions drop
  Evans's marks; witness "hynny"); as in mabinogi-003 (col 25 l. 3). NOTE: = *hynny*.
- col 45 l. 30 — **"ar benn gossed"** (Evans *goſſed*, zoom-8 crop, certain; witness "gorssed"; the Red Book
  *gorssed*). A readable slip for *gorssed* 'mound'; kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 46 l. 36 — **"guassanaethu"** (Evans *guaſſanaethu*; witness "guassaneuthu").
- col 47 l. 17 — **"A neb ny dieghis"** (Evans *ný*; witness "ni").
- col 41 c. l. 14 — "nachaf Efnyssen gwr anagneuedus": the witness's "[y]" is not in the White Book and the sense does
  not need it: not supplied.

## Supplied from the Red Book
- col 46 l. 16 — **"A chyn penn y pedwyryd mis"**: the White Book has no word after *pedwyryd* ('the fourth' with
  nothing for it to count — the only period named before it is *y ulwydyn*); the Red Book has *pedwyzyd mis*.
  Supplied **"mis"** only (the witness also brackets it). NOTE FOR DRAFTER: say the word is supplied from the Red Book.

## Other spots
- col 39 c. l. 17 — Evans spaces "yn rac ulaenu"; written *raculaenu* as one word (the compound verb), as the witness.
- col 40 c. l. 16 — "eyniuer" written "e yniuer" as the witness (word division ours).
- col 40 c. l. 26 — "llongheu" (zoom-8 crop; witness agrees).
- col 42 c. l. 29 — **"Bronwen"** (Evans *bron-wen* across the line; witness agrees): the White Book's spelling of the
  name here; kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 42 c. l. 10 — "ti a wely dangos ef": the Red Book has *dangos mae ef*; the White Book reads without *mae*; nothing
  supplied. NOTE: construe as printed.
- col 46 l. 9 — "ar benn y pethewnos a'r mi": Evans prints *ar mi* (the line before has *a mis*); the Red Book *armis*.
  A readable slip for *a'r mis*; kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 46 c. l. 12 — "yu gossymdeithaw" (Evans *ýugoſſýmdeithaw*), as the witness.
- Punctuation repairs to the witness: single quotes round the king's first speech → “ ”; "a'r guare," closing a
  speech → "a'r guare.”"; Matholwch's tale (cols 45–47) is one speech, the giant's dialogue inside it marked ‘ ’
  (as mabinogi-003 marks nested speech).
- Paragraphs (ours): ten — the house of Llŷr; the ships and the parley; the council, Aberffraw and the wedding night;
  Efnysien and the horses; the news to Matholwch; Bendigeidfran's first messengers; the second embassy; the return
  to the court; the second feast and the cauldron; the cauldron's story.

Supplied: "mis" (col 46). Kept slips for the notes: *Penardim*, *gwnaetpwyt*, *yn ymdidan*, *hyny*, *gossed*,
*Bronwen*, *a'r mi*, *dangos ef* (Red Book *dangos mae ef*).
